jobs.title: Business Development Operations Associate
jobs.why: Excellent overlap across operations and systems: the role owns day-to-day Salesforce/CRM operations, AI-assisted reporting automations, executive reporting, cross-functional timelines, partner workflows, and process building. The stated 2-3 years of operations, coordination, analyst, or client-facing experience is also relatively accessible.
jobs.gap: Financial-services and partnerships exposure are helpful, so Audrey should emphasize transferable CRM ownership, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and process improvement rather than trying to present herself as a finance specialist.

jobs.title: Business Analyst II
jobs.why: Strong business-systems match centered on stakeholder discovery, business and technical process documentation, functional and non-functional requirements, solution scoping, and implementing process changes. It closely mirrors Audrey's requirements/UAT/business-systems positioning.
jobs.gap: This is an Analyst II role, so Audrey should make independent ownership of small-to-medium projects, requirements elicitation, UAT, and implementation outcomes prominent on Resume A.

jobs.title: Business Process Analyst
jobs.location: New York City area / Eastern Time (Remote)
jobs.why: Good implementation-oriented BA match: customer-facing platform implementations, process analysis, project coordination, cross-functional business/technical collaboration, and helping users adopt and support an internal logistics platform. The role is remote for U.S. Eastern Time candidates.
jobs.gap: Logistics, purchase-order, and supply-chain domain knowledge is the clearest gap. Audrey should emphasize platform implementation, process mapping, user support, and any integration-adjacent work; API/EDI familiarity is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.why: Strong functional UX alignment across Figma, end-to-end user flows, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, user research, usability testing, accessibility, and Product/Engineering collaboration. It is remote and based on Eastern Time.
jobs.gap: Talkspace asks for 4+ years of professional UX experience across web, iOS, and Android, making this a stretch. Audrey needs a polished portfolio and should only prioritize it if her projects can convincingly demonstrate production-level end-to-end product design.

jobs.title: Systems Analyst II
jobs.why: High-upside systems role with strong overlap in Salesforce/GTM tooling, workflow automation, stakeholder discovery, systems implementation, change management, training coordination, data-backed recommendations, and AI-enabled process improvement. The role targets roughly 2-4 years of systems/BizOps/TechOps experience.
jobs.gap: The technical bar is significant: working proficiency in JavaScript, Python, SQL, and APIs is requested. Audrey should treat this as a stretch unless she can demonstrate hands-on technical tooling or automation work beyond Salesforce configuration and business analysis.
